Senior / Staff Product Designer

We are an established product company that believes craft and quality have lasting value. Design has a seat at the table here — our founders are designers, and quality is our competitive advantage. You will live with one product for years, continuously improving it from v1 to v3 and beyond.

What you'll do:
- Own product design work end to end — from beginning to end, no hand-offs — pairing closely with engineering.
- Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique; raise the bar for craft across the team.
- Help with hiring new teammates by participating in portfolio reviews and interviews.
- Use and improve our lightweight design system components; keep hands-on making at the center of your week.
- Shape how the design practice adopts AI-assisted workflows and emerging tools.

How we work:
- Fully distributed and async-first, with intentional in-person moments a few times a year.
- Flexible hours; we plan sustainable cycles, not sprints. No hustle culture.
- This is an individual contributor position: no direct reports, no performance management. You are measured on the quality of the product design you personally ship.

About you:
- 8+ years designing digital products with deep care for detail and craft.
- You love being in the work — Figma weekly is a given — and you make other designers better through example and critique.

Remote within North America. Salary is competitive and transparent.
